prompt: I need a data table component for our dashboard. It should handle sorting, filtering, pagination, and row selection. The table should use as much viewport as possible and work well on mobile (card-based layout on small screens, table on desktop). We use unigrid.css directly, no Bootstrap or Tailwind.

assertions.text: Has both smart (container) and dumb (presentational) components with clear separation
All components use separate .html and .scss files, never inline
Mobile view uses card-based layout instead of table
Desktop view (md+ breakpoint) uses proper table layout
Table uses full available viewport width, not a narrow centered container
Row heights use leading-based spacing (multiples of --ug-leading)
SCSS uses unigrid.css tokens (--ug-spacing-*, --ug-leading, ug-grid classes)
Sort buttons, pagination, and row selection are keyboard accessible
Interactive elements (sort buttons, pagination, checkboxes) meet 44px minimum
Stories include: Default, Empty, Loading, WithFilters states
Includes a standalone HTML mockup showing responsive table behavior
